decision_conditions: The refuse and recycling facilities serving the residential unit hereby approved shall be provided in full accordance with drawing ref. 001 (Site Location Plan, Proposed Ground Floor Plan, Front Elevation and Section A-A) and shall be permanently retained and maintained for that purpose thereafter.The developer and/or their successors in title shall take all reasonable steps to ensure that all refuse and recyclable materials associated with the development are either stored within these facilities or internally within the building, and that no refuse or recycling material is stored or placed for collection on the public highway except on the day of collection.Reason: To ensure satisfactory refuse and recycling provision in the interests of the character and appearance of the area and the living conditions of neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with Policy SI17 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy (2012).
